context: Ren and Mei chat after a planetarium visit.
purpose: Casual reflective register reusing stragglers (宇宙/演奏/つもり/残念/知る) naturally.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: プラネタリウム、宇宙が綺麗だったね。
lines.en: The planetarium — the universe was beautiful.
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle dreamy delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うん、背景の演奏も良かったね。
lines.en: Yeah, the background music was good too.
lines.style: warm young man voice, soft warm reflective delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 宇宙のことを、もっと知りたくなった。
lines.en: I got curious to know more about space.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm engaged delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 次は、別の回も見るつもりだよ。
lines.en: I plan to see another showing next time.
lines.style: engaged young man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 今日で終わりなのが、残念だな。
lines.en: It's a shame today's the last one.
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm wistful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 演奏付きの回は、また来るらしいよ。
lines.en: The showings with music are coming back, apparently.
lines.style: reassuring young man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 知れて良かった。絶対行くつもり!
lines.en: Glad to know. I'm definitely planning to go!
lines.style: bright woman voice, soft warm delighted delivery throughout
